election_accepted.title: Auto-editor election: { candidate_name }
election_accepted.opening_message: Voting in the latest election has closed!
election_accepted.accepted_message: Candidate { candidate_name } has been accepted as an auto-editor.
election_accepted.election_thanks: Thank you to everyone who took part.
election_accepted.new_autoeditor_welcome_intro: And { candidate_name }, congratulations on becoming an auto-editor! With great power comes great responsibility - please familiarise yourself with the below.
election_accepted.new_autoeditor_welcome_1: Your new privileges, as well as your obligations as an auto-editor, can be found here.
election_accepted.new_autoeditor_welcome_2: In summary, you have more voting rights, and we expect familiarity with the Code of Conduct, adherence to the Style Guidelines, and a high standard of objectivity on edits and votes.
election_accepted.new_autoeditor_welcome_3: You have also been given access to the Autoeditor category of the forums, and, once you’re confident enough, you can start auto-editor elections yourself.

election_rejected.title: Auto-editor election: { candidate_name }
election_rejected.opening_message: Voting in the latest election has closed!
election_rejected.rejected_message: Candidate { candidate_name } has not been accepted as an auto-editor.
election_rejected.election_thanks: Thank you to everyone who took part.
election_rejected.not_forever_reminder: Remember that editors can be proposed multiple times - many auto-editors are elected in repeat elections, after being asked to improve some aspects of their editing.
